    def ev(expr, claim, steps=(), options=None, option=None):

        if options: ir["options"] = options
        ca = {"kind": "value", "payload": claim}
        if option: ca["option"] = option
        return verify(ir, {"claimed_answer": ca, "steps": [{"id": f"s{i}", "kind": k, "claim": c, "from": [], "text": ""} for i, (k, c) in enumerate(steps)]}).verdict

    print(ev("(cos(pi/3) + I*sin(pi/3))**3", "1"), ev("(sqrt(3) + I)**6", "64"), ev("((sqrt(3) + I)/2)**12", "12"))  # CORRECT x3

    print(ev("(1 + sqrt(3)*I)**3", "-8", steps=[("eq", "(1 + sqrt(3)*I)**3 = 5")]))  # CORRECT, adım verified
    print(ev("Abs((1 + sqrt(3)*I)**3 + 30)", "22"), ev("cbrt((1 + sqrt(3)*I)**3 + 35)", "3"))  # INCORRECT INCORRECT (haksız ret)
